scripts.syntax: set -e; for f in popup.js background.js popup_*.js volt_premium.js admin*.js content.js chatUIInjected.js bg/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.audit:cws: npm run syntax && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:check && node scripts/validate-dist.js
